buzz.objective: Operate Buzz as a controlled, persistent, event-driven agent environment.
buzz.current_architecture: Buzz Desktop and relay for collaboration; OpenClaw for gateway, tasks, schedules, audit and model providers; Phase 1 observer adds deterministic event, policy, validation and state layers.
buzz.current_status: Phase 1 commissioned; automatic private-channel briefing and canonical Bumble identity are active under explicit owner decisions.
rationale: Reduce unnecessary model use and human intervention without weakening safeguards.
dependencies: Ollama or llama.cpp when local inference is needed
unresolved_issues: Sentinel managed runtime activity metadata differs from the live bridge state.
risks: Configuration drift between Buzz personas, team templates and managed runtimes.
next_actions: Collect reliability evidence before considering any additional A2 action.
Decide whether to deploy the prepared observe-only Rook watchdog replacement.

macmini-optimisation.objective: Improve the Mac Mini as a stable, observable and resource-aware AI automation host.
macmini-optimisation.current_architecture: macOS launchd hosts Buzz, OpenClaw, Ollama/llama.cpp, Tailscale and Home Assistant connectivity; Buzz and the existing Home Assistant VM recover after login while FileVault remains enabled.
macmini-optimisation.current_status: Phase 1 source is on GitHub, Buzz briefing publication is active, and after-login recovery is loaded.
major_decisions: Phase 1 max general autonomy is A1
One fixed private-channel publication is owner-approved
Keep FileVault enabled and recover services after login
rationale: Observation must be reliable before reversible automation is considered.
unresolved_issues: The selected 160 GB external disk requires erasure and APFS reformatting before Time Machine can use it.
Measure local model memory, latency and swap behaviour in Phase 2.
risks: Cold reboot still requires a FileVault user login
next_actions: Preserve the existing Home Assistant backup and obtain explicit approval before erasing the external disk.

smart-home-control.objective: Maintain safe, deterministic Home Assistant-centred control.
smart-home-control.current_architecture: Home Assistant is the deterministic control plane; Buzz is the review and orchestration surface.
smart-home-control.current_status: Existing project retained; not modified by this Phase 1 build.
